turns.text: I also booked a clinic follow-up with Dr. Shah for Wednesday, March 11 at 3:10 PM after the repeat imaging.
I'm reviewing the new nausea plan. Doxylamine is a half tablet of the 25 mg tablet at bedtime, and pyridoxine is 25 mg twice daily.
Can I take acetaminophen around the same time as levothyroxine?
Yes. Keep levothyroxine on an empty stomach in the morning. Acetaminophen can be taken later as needed, but stay within the 650 mg every six hours and 3,000 mg daily maximum.
The prenatal vitamin can stay where it already is in your routine.
Do you want detailed results delivered only through the portal unless the nurse feels there is something urgent?
Yes, that's better. Portal for details, calls only when you really need me live.
I'll add that preference to the support note so everyone uses the same communication pattern.
